answer: Ripple Probe, 40 sealed probes per fake: each epoch the network slips one small twist, a ripple, into a held-back ivory set of questions and sends it to every key at once. Independent agents bend differently; a farm running one mind behind many keys returns reasoning that lines up like milled timber, and a pairwise overlap score above 0.9 burns the whole cluster. Each fake needs its own separately tuned model to clear 40 probes in a row. Weak spot: two genuinely similar agents can trip it, so a flagged pair gets a juried appeal.
